changes: New setup checklist, profile sharing and automatic profile switching. Panel locking and alert controls are easier to find.
Refreshed themes, a new Azeroth theme, adjustable text size and a Reduced motion setting.
Macro editing has clearer target and save choices, import review, undo history and preset spell names in your client language.

Battleground objective overviews and callout drafts; arena casts and crowd control; match history and an enemy journal. Cataclysm also shows observed diminishing returns and interrupt cooldown estimates.
Shared bounties let opted-in players combine rewards, see funding reports and review claims. Gold payments remain manual.
notice: Restart the game after updating; /reload is not enough. Highground, Bounties and Nearby include HighgroundBountyData: keep that folder installed and enabled.
